title: Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
body:
Tu na aaya ghazi
(Haaye Mere Abbas) x4
<<MINI>>
(Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aale-Imraan Kahaan, Aur Zindaan Kahaan
Ye Behen Qaid Huwi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
<<MINI>>
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hamko Paani Na Mile, Teri Khushbu Toh Rahe
Tere Baazu Na Kate, Chaahe Mashkiza Chhide
Yeh Magar Ho Na Saka, Tere Baazu Hai Judaa, Mujhpe Hai Tashna-Labi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
2. Dhup Mai Tu Thaa Shajar, Tujhse Aabaad Thaa Ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Barehna Mera Sar, Kya Nahin Tujhko Khabar
Ay Alamdaare-Wafaa, Is Behen ko bakhuda
Tujhse Dhaaras Thi Badi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
3. Aagayi Shaam-e-Alam, Lutgaye Ehle-Haram
<<DIVIDER>>
Ret Par Jalti Huwi, Hogaya Thanda Alam
Pursaa Dene Ke Liye, Mujhse Milne Ke Liye
Aagaye Baba Ali, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
4. Kya Kahun Sher Mere, Beridaa Hamko Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Musalmaa(n) Saare, Shehr dar Shehr Gaye
Khilqate Kufa Kabhi, Khilqate Shaam Kabhi
Baaraha Ham Pe Hassi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
5. Kitni Bebas Thi Behen, Ai Shehenshaahe Wafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Naam Leleke Mera, Jab Ye Zaalim Ne Kahaa
Naaz Tha Jispe Tujhe, Ab Bulaaona Usse Aur Mai Roti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
6. Qaid Khaane Mai Qazaa, Jab Sakina Ko Mili
Deke Kurte Ka Kafan, Bacchi Dafnaayi Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Us Ghari Naam Tera, Surate Naade-Ali
Bas Mai Dohraati Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
Khun Mai Dub Gaya, Mere Ghazi Ka Alam
Zakhmi Zainab Ka Jigar, Khun-Fishaa'n Shah Ka Sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaye Khaimon Mai Shaqi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
<<MINI>>
Jab Ridaa Sar Se Chhini, Mai Sadaa Deti Rahi, Tu Na Aaya Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tu Na Aaya Ghazi) x2
